text: In May 2025, Health Canada announced a recall of ProXpédition hunting scent products lacking required consumer chemical labelling; the company reported 17,532 units sold in Canada.
source_quote: The company reported that 17, 532 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
notes: Verified against the source page's raw HTML on 2026-11-06. Health Canada recall RA-77378, original published date 2025-05-05. Source: products 'do not have the proper consumer chemical labelling as required by the Consumer Chemicals and Containers Regulations, 2001'. Five scent/lure products; manufacturer ProXpédition, Blainville QC. The stray space in '17, 532' is in the source; the claim normalises it to 17,532.
